title: Parse durations, in a module that already defines the units
prompt: In src/time.js, add an exported function parseDuration(text) that turns strings such as '1h30m', '45s', '2h' and '1h5m10s' into milliseconds. Units are h, m and s, each used at most once and in that order, each with a whole number. Return null for anything else, including the empty string. Tests run with: npm test
